extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset containing 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.publisher: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanjing University, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Innovation Institute
extraction.citeAs: Li, X., Wang, Y., Yu, J., et al. VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. arXiv:2501.00574.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Leveraged the rich diversity of existing datasets (Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, MiraData) encompassing movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, and how-to videos. Generated dense event labels for each long video and constructed QA pairs based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Filtered consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence. Constructed a sequence of event labels with corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations, utilized them directly as event labels. For others, extracted the major event from the caption using an LLM. Constructed QA pairs based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Generated dense event labels for each long video. Utilized existing high-quality short video captions (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, original captions for MiraData). For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D), utilized them directly. For others, extracted the major event from the caption using an LLM. Constructed QA pairs for five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Egocentric video data, Interview video data
